label: D1 after reward, agent moderately leaning to a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2) and almost only when the reward input is 1 (99.7% of mass). Within rewarded D1 steps it is selective for the a1 side: 98% of activations precede an a1 choice (upcoming choice, which the agent computes), and almost all fall where the policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) at D1 is moderately positive (about 3 to 8). It does not fire before a2 choices, on unrewarded D1, or at extreme a1 confidence. Baseline (phase==D1)&(in_rew==1)&(action==1) gives dev F1 0.55 with mass recall 1.00; the recorded choice-band version gives dev F1 0.79, mass recall 0.92. Magnitude (checked in example windows): largest on the first reward after unrewarded trials, then decays steadily across consecutive rewarded trials (e.g. 0.99, 0.78, 0.55, 0.37). Rate also falls with episode time (none after trial ~90). The remaining false positives are rewarded a1-leaning D1 steps after long reward streaks or late in the episode, so this is partly a habituating reward-for-a1 signal. Uses only observed inputs and the model own policy readout; no future variables.
